reason: After thorough review of the Fortive Corporation (FTV) 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were found disclosed by the company itself. The filing contains extensive business descriptions, segment information, and financial data for the Intelligent Operating Solutions and Advanced Healthcare Solutions segments, but does not include any company-disclosed TAM estimates, market size figures, or addressable market quantifications in the Business section, MD&A, or elsewhere in the document.
